name: cc-better-questions
description: Questions answered in a form: open, multiple choice and yes/no, in place of AskUserQuestion.

blocking.title: Wait for answers
blocking.description: true: Claude waits for your answers. false: Claude keeps working and gets your answers when you submit or close the form.

disableWaitForAnswers.title: Turn off wait-for-answers
disableWaitForAnswers.description: Only when "Wait for answers" is off. false: Claude can wait for your answers once it has nothing else to do. true: it ends its turn instead, and gets your answers in a message when you submit.

disableAskUserQuestion.title: Turn off AskUserQuestion
disableAskUserQuestion.description: true: the built-in AskUserQuestion tool is turned off, so every question uses this form. It stays on when no terminal is attached, since the form can't be answered there.
